charts.style: Clean, minimal grid lines, rounded bars, smooth curves for line charts

general: Implement a 'Mobile-First' approach. Ensure all grids collapse to 1 column on mobile.
Use the 'Deep Emerald' primary color for main actions and branding.
Use 'Sonner' for all toast notifications (success, error, alerts).
Ensure all financial values are formatted with the Brazilian Real (R$) currency symbol and locale (pt-BR).
Use 'Outfit' font for all headings and 'Public Sans' for body text. Import them via Google Fonts in index.css.
Do NOT use gradients for text. Keep text high-contrast and readable.
For the Dashboard, use a 'Bento Grid' layout: Total Balance (Large), Quick Actions (Medium), Recent Transactions (Tall/List).
Implement 'Goals' as cards with progress bars. Use the provided images for specific goal examples.
Ensure the 'Export to Excel' button is prominent but secondary to daily actions.
accessibility: Ensure all text meets APCA contrast standards.
Add aria-labels to all icon-only buttons.
Support keyboard navigation for all interactive elements.
Use semantic HTML (main, section, article, nav).
testing: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).

universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic centered layouts or default blue colors.
Create depth: Use layered shadows and subtle borders.
Micro-interactions: Add hover states to all cards and buttons.
No generic gradients: Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Spacing: Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside cards.
